financing.summary: NOT a conventional for-sale homebuilder and not a direct land-banking customer. Lifestyle Homes (Scottsdale, AZ) is a privately owned, fee-based general contractor that builds build-to-rent communities on land owned and financed by its developer and investor clients, so it carries no lot inventory of its own that a land banker could take out. Its own funding (owner equity, any working-capital line, bonding) is not publicly disclosed; the only public hint is a conference listing saying it has been vetted by leading lenders. The financing that matters sits with its clients: Empire Group of Companies (15 of 24 listed projects), plus GTIS Partners, Dominium, El Dorado Holdings, Moderne Communities, Zen Investing and Higher Ground Developments. For Domain the value of this account is as a route to those build-to-rent land owners, not as a lot-option counterparty.
financing.land_strategy: Owns no land by design. The company says it began in 2009 buying raw land and finished lots for small infill for-sale communities, then moved to fee-based general contracting for build-to-rent communities; clients bring the land.

lots.note: No lot position: fee contractor building on clients' land. Activity measures instead: the company site cites 1,000+ pre-developed homes in progress and 2,000+ acres developed; a December 2025 trade article cites about 25 communities and 4,800+ rental homes built and 14 communities under construction.

land_banking.description: Largest client by far: named as the developer on 15 of the 24 build-to-rent communities on Lifestyle Homes' project list (the 'Village at ...' series across metro Phoenix and Pinal County). Empire owns the land and the finished community; Lifestyle Homes builds horizontal and vertical for a fee.
land_banking.note: Not a land-bank arrangement. 'lots' here is rental homes: the sum of the unit counts the company publishes for 14 of the 15 Empire projects (13 project pages plus Village at Olive Marketplace, 208 homes, on the home page; Village at Pioneer Park has no published count). Includes completed projects.

gaps: Lot counts: none; the company does not own or option lots (fee-based general contractor)
Credit facility, lenders, bonding/surety and owner capital: not publicly disclosed (private company)
Revenue, debt, cash and other financial metrics: not publicly disclosed beyond the Builder 100 revenue figure held in the spine
Ownership detail: Lance Keller is described as founder, owner and managing member; any other equity holders are not publicly disclosed
Land banker or lot-option partner: none, and none expected given the business model; no public link to Domain, Millrose, Kennedy Lewis or TPG Angelo Gordon was found
Client-level financing (who funds Empire Group's and the other developers' land and construction): not researched here; it belongs to those developers, not to this company

M&A 2025 to 2026: none found on the company site or in the articles opened, but the swarm's web search allowance ran out after two searches, so a dedicated news search for deals was not possible; treat as 'none found', not 'confirmed none'
Nevada and Texas activity: the company says it is licensed in Nevada and serves Texas, but no project in either state is on its project list
